originalTitle: U.S. military destroys five Iranian oil tankers after attempted attack on American warship, Centcom says
summary: The U.S. and Iran traded new attacks around the Strait of Hormuz, as President Donald Trump insists oil prices will drop fast once the Iran war ends.
content:
The U.S. military destroyed five Iranian crude oil tankers on Tuesday in retaliation for the Revolutionary Guard firing ballistic missiles at an American warship twice over the past two days, according to U.S. Central Command.

The U.S. warship successfully evaded Iranian attack and no American personnel were harmed, Centcom said in a statement .

U.S. forces struck four tankers in the Gulf of Oman, Centcom said. They are the M/T Kaviz, M/T Charminar, M/T Horizon 1 and M/T Riesco. The military hit the M/T Derya near Iran's Kharg Island.

"American forces directed the crews to abandon ship before the vessels were struck and rendered inoperable," Centcom said.

The U.S. and Iran have traded new attacks in the Persian Gulf in recent days, rekindling hostilities in the region even as the Trump administration shifts its strategy toward defeating Tehran economically .

The U.S. military destroyed three Iranian tankers on Saturday in retaliation for the Guard firing ballistic missiles at an aircraft carrier and a guided-missile destroyer. Those attacks also failed, Centcom said.

Earlier Tuesday, Centcom said an unmanned submersible that Iran reportedly seized in the Strait of Hormuz was "defective" and carried no sensitive data or classified equipment.

"An underwater drone operated by U.S. forces malfunctioned more than a day ago," U.S. Navy Captain Tim Hawkins told CNBC in a statement shared by U.S. Central Command.

The drone "was surveying regional waters in support of ongoing operations," Hawkins said, adding, "U.S. operations in area waters continue."

Iran's Revolutionary Guard had boasted earlier Tuesday that it trapped and captured "one of the most modern, intelligent, unmanned submarines of the American terrorist army at the entrance to the Strait of Hormuz," according to a translated post from Iranian state news outlet Fars.

Fars later posted videos and images purporting to show the vessel out of the water.

But Hawkins' statement insisted that the drone was hardly a crucial piece of cutting-edge military tech.

Read more CNBC politics and policy coverage

"The defective drone was an older model that neither collected sensitive data nor carried any classified sonar or radar equipment," the captain's statement said.

Iranian media outlets described the sub as a Dive-LD, an autonomous undersea vehicle developed by U.S. defense contractor Anduril . They cost $2.5 million each, DefenseScoop reported in 2024.

"Dive-LD is an attritable autonomous system, meaning it is designed from the outset to operate in dangerous environments where loss of the vehicle is an expected possibility," an Anduril spokesperson told CNBC when asked about the drone seizure. "Its purpose is to keep warfighters out of the most dangerous parts of the undersea mission. This vehicle had already delivered significant value operating thousands of hours in months-long operations in CENTCOM."

The spotlight on the watercraft offers the latest example of the U.S. military's increasing dependence on autonomous tech to fight the war in the Middle East.

This summer, unmanned boat startup Saronic used one of its drone vessels to rescue crew from a helicopter downed in the Hormuz Strait. Saronic's boats were later used in a strike on an Iranian submarine and ship facility.

— CNBC's Samantha Subin contributed to this report.
chineseTitle: 美国中央司令部称，美国军方在企图袭击美国军舰后摧毁了五艘伊朗油轮
chineseSummary: 美国和伊朗在霍尔木兹海峡周围发生了新的袭击，唐纳德·特朗普总统坚称一旦伊朗战争结束，油价将迅速下跌。
chineseContent:
据美国中央司令部称，美国军方周二摧毁了五艘伊朗原油油轮，以报复革命卫队过去两天两次向一艘美国军舰发射弹道导弹。

美国中央司令部在一份声明中表示，这艘美国军舰成功躲避了伊朗的袭击，没有美国人员受伤。

中央司令部表示，美军在阿曼湾袭击了四艘油轮。它们是 M/T Kaviz、M/T Charminar、M/T Horizo​​n 1 和 M/T Riesco。军方在伊朗哈格岛附近袭击了 M/T Derya 号。

中央司令部表示：“在船只被击中并无法使用之前，美军指示船员弃船。”

尽管特朗普政府将战略转向在经济上击败德黑兰，但美国和伊朗最近几天在波斯湾发生了新的袭击，重新点燃了该地区的敌对行动。

美国军方周六摧毁了三艘伊朗油轮，以报复伊朗卫队向一艘航空母舰和一艘导弹驱逐舰发射弹道导弹。中央司令部表示，这些攻击也失败了。

周二早些时候，中央司令部表示，据报道伊朗在霍尔木兹海峡扣押的一艘无人潜水器“有缺陷”，没有携带敏感数据或机密设备。

美国海军上尉蒂姆·霍金斯在美国中央司令部分享的一份声明中告诉 CNBC：“美军操作的一架水下无人机一天多前发生故障。”

霍金斯说，这架无人机“正在勘测地区水域，以支持正在进行的行动”，并补充说，“美国在该地区水域的行动仍在继续。”

据伊朗国家新闻媒体《法尔斯》翻译的帖子称，周二早些时候，伊朗革命卫队曾吹嘘称，他们在霍尔木兹海峡入口处捕获并捕获了“美国恐怖分子军队最现代化、最智能的无人潜艇之一”。

法尔斯后来发布了视频和图像，声称显示该船已脱离水面。

但霍金斯的声明坚称，无人机并不是尖端军事技术的关键部分。

阅读更多 CNBC 政治和政策报道

机长的声明称：“这架有缺陷的无人机是老式型号，既不收集敏感数据，也不携带任何机密声纳或雷达设备。”

伊朗媒体将这艘潜艇描述为 Dive-LD，这是一种由美国国防承包商安杜里尔 (Anduril) 开发的自主水下航行器。据 DefenseScoop 在 2024 年报道，每架飞机的成本为 250 万美元。

当被问及无人机被扣押事件时，Anduril 发言人告诉 CNBC：“Dive-LD 是一种可消耗的自主系统，这意味着它从一开始就被设计为在危险环境中运行，预计车辆可能会丢失。” “它的目的是让作战人员远离水下任务中最危险的部分。这辆车已经在中央司令部长达数月的行动中运行了数千小时，带来了巨大的价值。”

对船只的关注提供了美国军队越来越依赖自主技术来打中东战争的最新例子。

今年夏天，无人船初创公司 Saronic 使用其一艘无人机船营救在霍尔木兹海峡坠落的直升机上的船员。萨罗尼克的船只后来被用来袭击伊朗的一艘潜艇和船舶设施。

— CNBC 的 Samantha Subin 对本报告作出了贡献。
